title: DPLEvolve: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA — Artifact Evaluation
description: Artifact Evaluation repository for the MLCAD 2026 short paper: 'From Tool Invocation to Source-Mechanism Exploration: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA'. Provides automated environment setup, version-pinned builds, baseline evaluation scripts, and configuration files for reproducing the ReviewDSE framework's key results. The minimal validation path runs in under 40 minutes without LLM API calls; full reproduction requires Claude API access.
notes: This artifact requires the sibling repositories dpl_evolve_agent/ and OpenROAD-flow-scripts/ at the exact commits recorded in provenance/source-commits.json. The full LLM-powered DSE pipeline consumes ~2.15B tokens per design and requires Claude API credentials.
